import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long mod1 = 998244353L;
    static final long mod2 = 1000000007L;
    static long answer = 0;
    static long total;
    static long count1 = 0;
    static List<Long>[] values = new ArrayList[7];
    static long[] totalSum = new long[7];
    static long[] powerOfTen = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};
    static long count2 = 0;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        total = Long.parseLong(br.readLine().trim());
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            values[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        generateValues(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(values[i]);
        }
        count2 = -1;
        explore(0, 0);
        System.out.println(answer);
    }

    static void generateValues(int level, long prefix) {
        if (level == 7) return;
        long val = (count1 - prefix + mod1) % mod1;
        values[level].add(val);
        totalSum[level] += val;
        count1++;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            generateValues(level + 1, prefix * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static boolean isInRange(long x) {
        final long half = 1000000L;
        return x * half + 999999L <= total && x * half * 10 > total;
    }

    static void explore(int level, long number) {
        if (number > total) return;
        if (isInRange(number)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long offset = ((count2 + 1 - (number * powerOfTen[i]) % mod1) + mod1) % mod1;
                int pos = lowerBound(values[i], (mod1 - offset) % mod1);
                long sumVal = (totalSum[i] + offset * values[i].size() - mod2 * (values[i].size() - pos)) % mod2;
                answer = (answer + sumVal) % mod2;
            }
            count2 += count1;
        } else {
            count2++;
            long temp = ((count2 - number) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1;
            answer = (answer + temp) % mod2;
            for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
                if (level == 0 && digit == 0) continue; // skip leading zeros if needed
                explore(level + 1, number * 10 + digit);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }
}
